# RK AI Labs

> RK AI Labs is an IT Business Analysis and AI product studio based in Delhi NCR, India. We pair senior business analysis with hands-on AI product engineering — taking organisations from ambiguous problems and fuzzy requirements all the way to shipped AI products and automations.

We do both halves most firms split: senior business analysis *and* AI product engineering, under one roof. Clarity before code; build to learn; AI accelerates, judgment decides.

## Services

- [Business Analysis as a Service](https://iamrohankapoor.com/services/business-analysis-as-a-service): An on-demand senior IT Business Analyst embedded with your product & engineering teams — epics, user stories, backlog ownership, discovery workshops.
- [Requirements & Process Discovery](https://iamrohankapoor.com/services/requirements-process-discovery): Turn a fuzzy idea or broken process into a clear, build-ready specification with as-is/to-be process maps, BRD/FRD, success metrics and acceptance criteria.
- [AI Product MVP Build](https://iamrohankapoor.com/services/ai-product-mvp-build): Go from problem statement to a working AI prototype real users can try — in six weeks, with a baseline, evaluation, guardrails and a user pilot.
- [LLM & GenAI Integration](https://iamrohankapoor.com/services/llm-genai-integration): Add LLM-powered features — copilots, retrieval-augmented chat, document understanding, agents — to your existing product, with evaluation and safe, flagged rollout.
- [Intelligent Workflow Automation](https://iamrohankapoor.com/services/intelligent-workflow-automation): Automate repetitive operational and back-office workflows with AI in the loop, combining rules, APIs and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
- [AI Readiness Assessment & Roadmap](https://iamrohankapoor.com/services/ai-readiness-assessment-roadmap): A focused audit of your data, processes and opportunities, delivering a prioritised, ROI-ranked AI roadmap.
